items.title_me: GTA VI za jedan dan zaradio 3,79 milijardi dolara
items.title_en: GTA VI earned $3.79 billion in a single day
points_me: Rockstar Games kaže da je prodaja prvog dana dostigla 3,79 milijardi dolara, rekord za zabavnu industriju u bilo kom mediju.
Prije izlaska prodato je 32,5 miliona primjeraka.
Dostupna je na PlayStationu 5 i Xboxu Series X|S.
points_en: Rockstar Games says day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion, a record for entertainment in any medium.
32.5 million copies were sold before launch.
The game holds a score of 99 on Metacritic.
Out now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
items.story_me: Rekord za zabavnu industriju u bilo kom mediju.
items.story_en: A record for entertainment in any medium.
items.caption_me: Grand Theft Auto VI je prvog dana prodaje zaradio 3,79 milijardi dolara, objavio je Rockstar Games. Prije izlaska prodato je 32,5 miliona primjeraka, a igra ima ocjenu 99 na Metacriticu.
items.caption_en: Grand Theft Auto VI made $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, Rockstar Games says. It sold 32.5 million copies before launch and holds a 99 on Metacritic.

items.title_me: Microsoft gasi aplikaciju To Do 30. juna 2027.
items.title_en: Microsoft is shutting down To Do on June 30, 2027
points_me: Aplikacije se gase na webu, Windowsu, Macu, iOS-u i Androidu.
Postojeći zadaci se neće automatski prebaciti u Planner.
Za lične Microsoft naloge nema zamjene.
Microsoft obećava opciju izvoza podataka prije gašenja.
points_en: The apps retire on the web, Windows, Mac, iOS and Android.
Existing tasks will not move to Planner automatically.
There is no replacement for personal Microsoft accounts.
Microsoft promises a data export option before the shutdown.
items.story_me: Zadaci se neće automatski prebaciti. Za lične naloge nema zamjene.
items.story_en: Tasks won't move automatically. No replacement for personal accounts.
items.caption_me: Microsoft gasi aplikacije To Do 30. juna 2027. na svim platformama. Postojeći zadaci se neće automatski prebaciti u Planner, a za lične naloge nema zamjene.
items.caption_en: Microsoft will retire the To Do apps on June 30, 2027 on every platform. Existing tasks won't move to Planner automatically, and there's no replacement for personal accounts.
